name: tracker-plain-language-asks
goal: Prove Tracker sends tool and process questions to Chief of Staff without increasing Daniel’s Needs You list, keeps real decisions answerable, and teaches both launch paths the same plain-language rule.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The question recorded on 26vq3c used Tracker command names and asked how to apply authorized cleanup. Structured choices satisfied the CLI and the question reached Daniel. It belongs in the Chief of Staff inbox.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The CLI channel case covers missing choices, but previously omitted valid structured flags with tool jargon and process questions. Strengthen it and assert the plain-language rule on native briefs and canonical agent instructions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At e005cab06c the original wording got exit 0 instead of exit 1. Native and canonical brief checks failed on missing plain-English guidance.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Flag lint uses the existing Chief of Staff route. Native and canonical launch instructions share the same plain-English guidance, mirrored and verified in the installed hand-launch template.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged three-file regression passed at the fix commit. The executable hub-and-spoke test on harbor-mbp-2 also showed a technical ask in Chief of Staff attention, absent from Daniel's flagged list, followed by a valid Daniel decision.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
